{{Spoiler}}

'''Chorus mochi''' is the meal of [[Chorus Fruit|chorus fruit]]. It heals {{Value|Chorus Mochi|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Levitation}} {{Value|Chorus Mochi|level|effect=Levitation|format=roman}} for {{Value|Chorus Mochi|duration|effect=Levitation}}, launching the player high into the air.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/chorus_mochi.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Popped Chorus Fruit|Popped chorus fruit]], a snowball, sugar, a [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]] and dough make 4. The recipe is taught by a [[Cooking Recipe]] sold by a Journeyman [[Cook]]. The milk bottle's glass bottle is meant to be given back, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so it is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating chorus mochi takes {{Value|Chorus Mochi|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Chorus Mochi|heals}} and gives Levitation {{Value|Chorus Mochi|level|effect=Levitation|format=roman}} (level {{Value|Chorus Mochi|level|effect=Levitation}}) for {{Value|Chorus Mochi|duration|effect=Levitation|format=clock}}.

=== Trading ===
A Journeyman Cook sells 16 chorus mochi for 1 [[obol]].
